notes.title: Weirdo – Save System Enhancement Update V 1.0.2.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067702/a69faa0764b4921154e4a0392e707288f2d16f3a.jpg[/img]
1. [b]Save System Overhaul[/b]: The enhanced save functionality now accurately records the current game state. Upon loading a save, players will return directly to the scene and progress they saved, ensuring a seamless experience and significantly improving gameplay.  
2. [b]Art and UI Improvements[/b]: We’ve refined certain visual assets and user interface elements, from color schemes to layout, polishing every detail for a more beautiful and fluid overall appearance.  
3. [b]New B-Key Shortcut[/b]: A quick-skip dialog feature via the B key (right mouse button) has been added. When replaying sections or skipping dialogue, players can simply press B to swiftly bypass dialog, streamlining game progression.  
4. [b]Logo Expansion[/b]: Added a Japanese title logo and a Traditional Chinese logo to further enhance language support and cater to the aesthetic and cultural preferences of players in different regions.  
5. [b]Notebook Fix[/b]: Resolved an issue where the dialog log interface behaved abnormally the first time the notebook was opened, ensuring players can view and navigate their dialog history without any problems.  
6. [b]UI Scroll Fix[/b]: Fixed a bug where the UI scrollbar couldn’t automatically track the selected position on first open. Now, whether opening for the first time or during subsequent use, the scrollbar precisely locates the focus for more convenient and efficient navigation.

notes.title: Parallel "Weirdo" is Now Available! Looking Forward to Your Experience.
notes.content:
[h1]Game Overview[/h1]
Weirdo is an absurd, quirky campus horror story and an alternative love simulation visual novel game.
It’s the third game in the Parallel series based on the comics, blending comic panel storytelling with the visual novel game genre.
The story unfolds at the mysterious Di Ying Ling High School, a place full of eerie legends and strange happenings (as mentioned in the previous works Concealed and Ghost in the Pool).
The protagonist, Wang Zhe, has a "disastrous" appearance but possesses some unique abilities. By day, he's a straight-A student acing his studies, and by night, he delves into biochemistry research left by his father.
In terms of gameplay, players will step into Wang Zhe's shoes and progress through the linear story by date. After class each day, they gather important clues by eavesdropping. Players can then explore different locations, triggering dialogues with various girls who have distinct personalities, leading to branching plotlines.
Players must use their instincts or the clues they’ve gathered to answer each girl’s questions within a limited time, choosing the correct gift to increase her affection. Once the affection reaches a certain level, players will unlock different endings and achievements.
As the story progresses, and based on certain player choices, hidden characters like the "Mermaid" and "Lizard Girl" will appear, adding a magical element to the narrative. The protagonist will also become entangled in campus "brotherhood" conflicts, and the physical changes happening to Wang Zhe will complicate things even further.
Weirdo blends campus horror, romance, superpowers, and multiple endings, offering players a unique gaming experience.

[h1]Project Details[/h1]
[h3]Q: Does Weirdo have any jump-scare horror elements?[/h3]
A: This time, the story of Weirdo leans more towards absurd and quirky with a bit of blood-pumping action, and it doesn't contain significant horror elements or jump-scare moments.

[h3]Q: How is the save system in Weirdo?[/h3]
A: Like most visual novels, Yiren provides 20 save slots per player account. Players can save and load at any time during gameplay. (For technical reasons, loading a save will resume from the current story point, and a small part of the previously played content might be re-read.) Each save can be deleted or overwritten. We also recommend saving before key decisions, so you can explore other branching paths later.

[h3]Q: What if I can't relate to the main character because of his appearance or behavior?[/h3]
A: The Parallel series focuses on absurd and quirky stories, often involving non-normal characters. The story of Weirdo is based on the original comic, which can be seen as a bizarre, quirky romance adventure of a scientific madman. We want players to approach the game with a sense of curiosity and see how this odd character ticks, whether he can actually win over his ideal girl, and how he gets his revenge on those who bully him.

[h3]Q: How long did the game take to develop, and what is the development team like?[/h3]
A: Weirdo was planned and developed after the release of Infiltration and took about a year to complete. The game was developed entirely by CASCHA and JOEY, with JOEY (Nine Days Ten Nights) being the author of the Parallel series(诡闻斋）. The comics have been serialized on platforms like U17 and Zongheng. CASCHA GAMES was established in 2021 after the release of their first game Substitute. The team has been working together for 4 years and has released three works in the series so far. In 2025, they plan to release more works in the series, so stay tuned!

[h3]Q: Will Weirdo be released on other platforms?[/h3]
A: After the Steam release, we plan to port Weirdo to the Nintendo Switch. If everything goes smoothly, it will be released on Switch later this year. We currently have no plans for other platforms.
